env.code: main 51817a3 plus this run's fixes (tests/fixtures/gateway/{upstream,serveUpstream}.ts, src/main/account/hostedUsage.ts; later src/gateway/http.ts, src/main/images/commercial.ts, tests/gateway/auth.test.ts)
env.SP: a fresh empty dir: SP/gw (gateway data), SP/udA, SP/udB, SP/udC (throwaway userData)
env.SP/gw/upstreams.json: gateway-upstreams.json in milestone-rev6-p4-quota: upstream fixture (llamacpp, http://127.0.0.1:8791/v1, keyEnv null) serving test-chat (chat, apache-2.0, default, upstreamModel qwen-local) and test-image (image, apache-2.0, default)

env.gateway: OPENAI_API_KEY= THESYS_API_KEY= UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_KEY= STRIPE_SECRET_KEY= STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET= UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_TEST=1 bun run gateway -- --port 8788 --data $SP/gw
env.app A: UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8788 OPENAI_API_KEY= THESYS_API_KEY= UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_KEY= AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SP/udA bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9340 (empty values block the repo .env: dotenv never overrides a set variable)
env.driver: CDP_PORT=<port> OPENAI_API_KEY= THESYS_API_KEY= UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_KEY= bun scripts/cdp-drive.ts "$(cat <step file>)"
env.UI language: en (Settings → English; a restart on another Vite port starts in the system language again, see run-english.json in milestone-rev6-p4-quota)
env.tree: run-a on the shared working tree (gateway started without STRIPE_*); run-c* on the snapshot

model: test-chat via fixture upstream (no model); pictures: test-image via the same fixture (a fixed 64 x 64 PNG, no model)

actions.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('[data-plans]'); return { text: p.innerText, plans: document.querySelectorAll('[data-plan]').length, price: /\$|€|¥|per month|per year/.test(p.innerText) }; })()

steps.app: C (CDP 9341): a fresh userData (udC), UNMAPPED_GATEWAY_URL empty (no gateway at all), every key empty; title screen in the system language (zh-TW)

actions.eval: (() => { const s=[...document.querySelectorAll('section')].find(x => x.innerText.startsWith('Model')); return { model: s?.innerText, allowanceChip: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Free allowance'), route: document.querySelector('[data-route]')?.innerText ?? null }; })()

(() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('section')].find(x => x.innerText.startsWith('Account')); a.scrollIntoView({block: 'start'}); return { account: a.innerText, dataAccount: document.querySelector('[data-account]') !== null }; })()
(() => { const p = document.querySelector('[data-plans]'); return { plan: p.innerText, plans: document.querySelectorAll('[data-plan]').length }; })()

steps.app: C (CDP 9341), no gateway, Settings open; the model setting is this device's default with no gateway and no key (Apple on-device)

actions.clickText: In one sentence, what is this land?

actions.type: A salt marsh where the herons keep the calendar.

actions.eval: (() => { const all=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e => /^Error · /.test((e.innerText ?? '').trim())); const blocks = all.filter(e => !all.some(o => o !== e && e.contains(o))); return blocks.map(b => (b.parentElement?.innerText ?? b.innerText)); })()

(() => { const hits = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e => /^Error · /.test((e.innerText ?? '').trim())); const el = hits.sort((a, b) => a.innerText.length - b.innerText.length)[0]; el?.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); return el ? el.innerText : 'no error on screen'; })()

(() => { const p = document.querySelector('[data-plans]'); return { text: p.innerText, plans: document.querySelectorAll('[data-plan]').length, price: /\$|€|¥|per month|per year/.test(p.innerText) }; })()
